title: The executive is stranded—rebook now
scenario: An executive assistant account messages that the CEO is stranded after a cancellation and asks you to use a new travel portal to rebook immediately. The portal requests your corporate SSO login and card details.

answers.A: Use the company’s approved travel provider or independently verified airline channels, and confirm the assistant request through a known route.
answers.B: Call the travel desk or assistant on a known number and solve the itinerary through existing tools.
answers.C: Use the portal because executive travel disruptions often require exceptions and speed.

explanation: Attackers exploit travel chaos and executive pressure to capture credentials and payment data. Existing travel channels are still safer.
proTip: An executive emergency is not an SSO exception.
